sources.title: GitHub - winson-du-ai/rknn-toolkit2_3588_npu
sources.snippet: RKNN-Toolkit2 is a software development kit for users to perform model conversion, inference and performance evaluation on PC and Rockchip NPU platforms. RKNN-Toolkit-Lite2 provides Python programming interfaces for Rockchip NPU platform to help users deploy RKNN models and accelerate the implementation of AI applications.

sources.title: GitHub - airockchip/rknn_model_zoo
sources.snippet: RKNN Model Zoo is developed based on the RKNPU SDK toolchain and provides deployment examples for current mainstream algorithms. Include the process of exporting the RKNN model and using Python API and CAPI to infer the RKNN model. Support RK3562, RK3566, RK3568, RK3576, RK3588 , RV1126B platforms. Limited support RV1103, RV1106 Support RV1109, RV1126, RK1808 platforms.

sources.title: How to Run CNN Models on RK3588 - sensecraft.seeed.cc
sources.snippet: How to Run CNN Models on RK3588 Convert YOLO11n on an Ubuntu PC, deploy it to RK3588 over SSH/SCP, and verify C++ and Python inference on its built-in NPU.

sources.title: RKNN Model Format | airockchip/rknn-toolkit2 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The RKNN model format is a sophisticated binary format that encapsulates neural network structures and associated data optimized for Rockchip NPU hardware. It provides a uniform representation that bridges the gap between AI frameworks and NPU execution, containing all the information necessary for efficient inference on target platforms.
